baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ءامنوا وعملوا الصالحات ... أجر غير ممنون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust becomes intentional action that opposes corruption; the resulting return is placed outside cutting or depletion. The verse thus links an inwardly secured stance, outward repair, and a continuously available yield.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the inwardly stabilized starting condition.
Heart-settling assent makes belief an operative commitment rather than a bare label.
Intentional action converts the settled commitment into purposive conduct.
Soundness against corruption gives the conduct its reparative direction.
Return for work supplies the consequence produced for the agents.
Exclusion and negation place the return outside the following limitation.
Cutting and diminution name the failure mode explicitly excluded from the return.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive an everlasting reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust issues in deliberate repair, and that repair yields a return kept outside every process of severance or depletion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of الصالحات and أجر, with غير ممنون qualifying the latter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repair branch of صالح and the fracture-setting branch of أجر form a material mechanism: reparative acts are answered by a mending that remains available even where damage has healed imperfectly. Non-cutting keeps that restorative response from expiring.

activation_trace.role: Opposition to corruption supplies the initiating work of restoration.
Setting a broken member, even with residual crookedness, recasts the return as compensatory mending.
The excluded cut makes the mending durable rather than a one-time settlement.

changed_reading.before: The reward is payment appended to good conduct.
changed_reading.after: The reward can also be heard as an enduring setting-right that answers acts of setting-right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative construction غير ممنون attached directly to أجر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation can exclude not only interruption but the social burden of a benefactor repeatedly invoking the favor. The return is therefore possessed without humiliation, leverage, or a rehearsed debt of gratitude.

activation_trace.role: A return due for action supplies the benefit granted to the recipients.
Categorical exclusion removes the following mode from the benefit.
Burdening a recipient by recounting a favor supplies the social debt that is excluded.

changed_reading.after: The reward is also never weaponized against its recipients as a favor they must keep repaying socially.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence distinguishes mere activity from صالح action. Work performed from behind a barrier is answered by straight orientation, giving, and growth; in 41:8, صالحات therefore become directed acts that reopen blocked relation and circulation.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action is the focus anchor whose quality the nearby contrast revises.
Removal of social estrangement makes صالحات capable of naming restored relation.
Prevention of access supplies the blocked relational condition from which rival work proceeds.
Intentional work on both sides shows that activity alone does not distinguish صالح work.
Straightness and rectitude supply the direction that turns activity into aligned action.
Giving supplies the outward transfer whose refusal marks the negative case.
Growth and increase make giving a circulation that produces life beyond the giver.

structural_cues: 41:5 ends with a challenge about work, 41:6 commands straight orientation, 41:7 names withheld giving, and 41:8 states the positive work-reward pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: barrier, rival work, straightness, giving, and growth. Reader arrow: صالح work reverses blockage by directed circulation. Live alternative: the sequence may only contrast obedience with disobedience without specifying a social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are a generic class of morally approved acts.
changed_reading.after: Righteous deeds are work that turns from guarded separation toward straight, life-producing circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence depicts habitability as a coordinated process of stabilizing, making good endure and grow, apportioning sustenance, equalizing access, and guarding the result. This activates صالح work as participation in maintained order and أجر غير ممنون as sustaining provision rather than a detached prize.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the analogy in the focus action.
Return for work is recast through the context as sustaining provision.
Non-severance gives the provision its continuing maintenance function.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the first operation of a habitable order.
Stable, growing good supplies durable fecundity rather than a static allocation.
Deliberate apportionment supplies the planning that coordinates provision.
Life-preserving sustenance supplies the concrete content of maintained provision.
Equity and a just middle supply the distributional shape of the provision.
Guarding and preservation complete the mechanism by keeping ordered good intact.

structural_cues: Immediately after 41:8, 41:9-12 unfolds creation through repeated operations of making, placing, blessing, measuring, assigning, and preserving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a stabilized, apportioned, nourished, and guarded world. Reader arrow: human صالح work participates analogically in that maintenance, and its reward has the form of maintained provision. Live alternative: the creation unit may function only as proof of divine power.

changed_reading.before: Good acts receive an indefinitely lasting payment.
changed_reading.after: Repairing acts join a world-maintaining economy, and their uncut return resembles provision continuously stabilized, apportioned, and preserved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later judgment scenes make action body-readable and repeatedly pair what was done with matching recompense. That sequence strengthens أجر as a consequence traceable to the work itself, while the adverse خالد counterpart sharpens غير ممنون as durable positive consequence.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the conduct whose trace later becomes legible.
Return for work anchors the focus consequence.
Exclusion of cutting gives the positive consequence temporal durability.
Presence with direct witnessing makes the deed evidentially available.
The bodily covering supplies the material surface that bears witness.
The explicit work recurrence ties bodily testimony to purposive conduct.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the directional return from deed to outcome.
Repetition of work makes the recompense explicitly answer what agents enacted.
Persistent abiding supplies the negative durable counterpart against which uncut reward is heard.

structural_cues: The formula بما كانوا يعملون recurs in 41:20 and 41:27, and 41:28 names the opposing جزاء and its abiding duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: bodily witness, repeated work formulas, matched recompense, and an abiding adverse outcome. Reader arrow: deeds leave embodied traces that mediate their own durable return. Live alternative: bodily testimony may be only courtroom evidence, not the mechanism of recompense.

changed_reading.before: Reward is externally assigned after deeds are reviewed.
changed_reading.after: Work becomes an embodied, witnessable trace whose fitting return persists rather than being arbitrarily appended.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later parallel portrait turns the focus root of faith-as-security into enacted security: steadfast agents are met by descent, release from fear, protective friendship, and prepared hospitality. The uncut reward is therefore an ongoing host-guest and guardian relation spanning present life and afterlife.

activation_trace.role: Inner security and trust anchor the state that the context externalizes.
The return for work is expanded from an object into a continuing relation.
Non-interruption lets guardianship cross the boundary between the two lives.
Steady rectitude supplies the sustained posture corresponding to focus faith and work.
Descent and arrival initiate the response that comes toward the steadfast agents.
Expected fear supplies the condition explicitly removed, realizing the security branch of faith.
Protective love and alliance supply the continuing personal relation in both lives.
Prepared hospitality for an arriving guest gives the reward its host-guest form.
Tender mercy supplies the manner in which that hospitality is maintained.

structural_cues: 41:30 reopens with إن الذين, echoing 41:8; 41:31 repeats ولكم فيها and explicitly spans الحياة الدنيا and الآخرة; 41:32 closes with نزلا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the focus echo, steadfastness, descent, no fear, allied protection, and hospitality. Reader arrow: these are the relational form of أجر غير ممنون. Live alternative: they may be examples of the reward's contents rather than a revision of what reward means.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an enduring possession awaiting believers.
changed_reading.after: The reward is enduringly being received, guarded, accompanied, and hosted across both lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact عمل صالح repetition is immediately unpacked as answering harm with what is better until enmity becomes intimate alliance. Self-restraint powers the conversion, while the 'great share' allows the reward to be heard partly as the acquired capacity and transformed relation already generated by صالح work.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation that removes estrangement anchors the social reading of صالحات.
Return for work anchors the possible present yield of transformed relation and capacity.
The repeated purposive action explicitly reconnects this unit to the focus formula.
The repeated reconciliation branch carries the focus category into the social sequence.
Doing what is better supplies the positive operation applied to incoming harm.
Removing a harmful thing supplies the directional action of the conversion.
Active enmity supplies the initial social state to be transformed.
Love, support, and alliance supply the resulting social state.
Near kinlike intimacy intensifies the endpoint beyond mere cessation of hostility.
Restraint of the self supplies the control needed not to mirror the hostile input.
A great allotted share supplies a possible name for the capacity or yield of this conversion.

structural_cues: 41:33 repeats عمل صالحا; 41:34 then presents an explicit before-and-after relation with فإذا; 41:35 twice restricts reception of the practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact focus repetition, better-for-harm displacement, enemy-to-intimate-ally conversion, restraint, and a great share. Reader arrow: the transformed relation and capacity are already part of the reward. Live alternative: حظ names only the rare qualification needed to perform the act.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work is approved conduct followed later by reward.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is a disciplined conversion of hostility into intimacy, and part of its unexhausted reward may be the new relation and capacity it produces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead-earth sequence gives restoration a temporal mechanism: supplied water enters, dormancy moves, the ground swells, and life returns across apparent death. Joined to the mending branch of أجر and the non-cut branch of ممنون, reward becomes regenerative continuity rather than a static stock.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the regenerative reading in صالح work.
Mending fracture supplies the restorative form of the resulting return.
Exclusion of severance lets restoration pass through an apparent endpoint.
Supplying water provides the enabling input to the dormant system.
Earth and vegetation moving with life provide the first visible activation.
Increase and rising supply the growth phase of the regenerative response.
Earth revived by rain supplies the completed restoration.
Loss of life supplies the apparent cut that the regenerative process crosses.

structural_cues: 41:39 explicitly moves from a humbled earth through water, motion, swelling, and revival, then applies the sequence to the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a complete dormant-to-living sequence and its explicit extension to resurrection. Reader arrow: this sequence models how صالح work and its reward can remain efficacious across interruption. Live alternative: the image may establish resurrection only, without describing reward.

changed_reading.before: Uncut reward is a quantity that simply continues.
changed_reading.after: Uncut reward is a capacity for life and repair to reactivate, swell, and cross what looked like a terminal break.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus begins with agents who enter trust; 41:40 contrasts fire with arriving secure and immediately reconnects that arrival to work under divine sight. Faith's lexical security can therefore be heard as the achieved form of the reward itself: a safe mode of arrival produced through visible action.

activation_trace.role: Settled security anchors the semantic state that later becomes an arrival condition.
Return for work anchors the claim that secure arrival can be one form of the reward.
Beneficial good supplies the evaluative contrast between the two arrivals.
Arrival in security realizes externally the condition latent in focus faith.
The doubled work occurrence ties the contrasted destination back to purposive conduct.
Seeing supplies continuous visibility of the work that leads into the arrival contrast.

structural_cues: Within one question-and-command sequence, 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure, then repeats اعملوا and تعملون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: secure arrival, contrasted destinations, doubled work, and divine sight. Reader arrow: the security latent in ءامنوا matures into the reward-state of آمنا. Live alternative: security is one promised outcome and need not redefine أجر.

changed_reading.before: Faith qualifies people to receive a separate reward.
changed_reading.after: The security entered through trust matures through visible work into secure arrival, so the reward partly realizes faith's own root image.

context_deltas.mechanism: 41:46 repeats the focus action almost verbatim and directs it 'for oneself,' while the withholding branch of ظلم is denied of the Lord. The focus lām in لهم is thus sharpened: صالح action has a reflexive benefit, and its due return is not withheld or diminished.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the exact action later repeated.
Repair against corruption anchors the positive work category later redirected to the self.
Return for work supplies the due benefit whose direction is clarified.
Non-diminution anchors the protection of that due benefit.
The repeated purposive work creates a direct backward link to the focus.
The repeated repair category identifies the same positive action.
The very self or thing itself supplies the inward direction of the action's benefit.
Withholding or blocking a right supplies the injustice explicitly denied, protecting the return from subtraction.

structural_cues: 41:46 gives the compact symmetry من عمل صالحا فلنفسه / ومن أساء فعليها and closes by denying ظلم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact repetition, benefit directed to self, harm against self, and denial of withheld right. Reader arrow: righteous action generates a reflexive yield that divine justice secures. Live alternative: the prepositions may identify only the beneficiary and bearer, not an intrinsic causal return.

changed_reading.before: A reward is transferred to believers from outside their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Righteous action already bends benefit back toward the doer, and the uncut reward is the just securing of that reflexive yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing anthropology shows mercy being claimed as private entitlement and favor followed by withdrawal. Against that unstable social economy, غير ممنون can mark a return free both from the giver's humiliating reminder and from the recipient's possessive boasting: bounty without relational leverage.

activation_trace.role: The granted return anchors the gift relation being reconsidered.
Negation excludes a corrupt mode of handling bounty.
Recounting a favor to burden its recipient supplies the leverage excluded from the reward.
Tender mercy supplies the bounty that the recipient immediately redescribes as possession.
Spoken assertion supplies the explicit possessive claim 'this is mine.'
A good condition bestowed as favor supplies the second bounty scene.
Turning one's side away supplies the recipient's relational withdrawal after favor.
Drawing one's side away intensifies withdrawal from the giver.

structural_cues: 41:50 places 'this is mine' immediately after received mercy; 41:51 places turning and distancing immediately after bestowed favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy, possessive speech, favor, and recipient withdrawal. Reader arrow: غير ممنون names bounty outside both boastful possession and humiliating leverage. Live alternative: the context diagnoses recipients only, while ممنون simply means interrupted.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an endless possession belonging to its recipients.
changed_reading.after: The reward is bounty that can be fully received without becoming either possessive self-credit or a favor used to control the receiver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the weight and release branches of ممنون with the wage branch of أجر, producing a paradoxical return beyond quota or quid pro quo. It remains anchored in the exact focus qualifier and its supplied branches. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary branch activation, not as a replacement for the strong 'uncut' reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر غير ممنون, especially the negated participle ممنون.

activation_trace.role: Compensation for work supplies the expected exchange frame.
Negation removes the following constraints from that exchange frame.
Release without counterpayment loosens the reward from strict quid pro quo.
A measured or weighed amount supplies the quota that the negation can place outside.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an infinitely extended wage.
changed_reading.after: Reward may exceed the wage form itself: released from counterprice and not exhausted by a measured allotment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The proposed reciprocity is surprising because the packet never states a causal bargain between tireless worship and uncut reward. It remains anchored through ممنون's cutting/exhaustion field and 41:38's explicit absence of weariness in continuing worship. Downstream prose should qualify it as a formal temporal echo, not a doctrine of earned equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غير ممنون as a return not cut off or exhausted.

activation_trace.role: Cutting, diminution, and exhaustion supply the interruption excluded from reward.
Continuous worship and praise supply the repeated practice on the action side.
Weariness from prolonged repetition supplies the interruption explicitly absent from that practice.

changed_reading.before: Only the reward has uninterrupted duration.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits a temporal resonance between unwearying devotion and a return that likewise never fatigues, diminishes, or stops.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and surprising because fruit sheaths and pregnancy are not explicit metaphors for reward in the focus ayah. It remains anchored in أجر as a return from work and ممنون as continuity, while 41:47 supplies concealed maturation followed by emergence. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for delayed yield, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر as the yield of عمل and غير ممنون as its non-severed continuation.

activation_trace.role: Purposive work supplies the initiating input whose yield may remain hidden.
Return from work anchors the analogy in the focus reward.
Non-severance lets hidden development remain connected to eventual yield.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the mature yield.
A plant's enclosing sheath supplies the hidden interval before emergence.
Inner bearing and fruiting supply a second process of concealed maturation.
Delivery of a carried burden supplies the transition from hidden process to manifest result.

changed_reading.before: Reward follows action in a visible ledger sequence.
changed_reading.after: A work's return may gestate unseen, remain connected through delay, and emerge later as mature benefit.

strongest_changes: The near context turns صالح work from generic goodness into directed circulation that reverses barriers and withholding.
41:30-32 realizes faith's security as continuing guardianship and hospitality across both lives.
41:33-35 specifies صالح action as enemy-to-ally conversion and lets transformed relation count as part of its yield.
41:40 and 41:46 recast reward as secure arrival and reflexive benefit, both tied directly to visible work.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing repeatedly converted a reward noun into mechanisms: maintained provision, embodied consequence, protective relation, social repair, regeneration, safe arrival, and benefit returning to the acting self. The repeated focus roots at 41:33, 41:40, and 41:46 made those changes especially traceable.
remaining_uncertainties: The uncut, non-humiliating, released, and unmeasured branches of ممنون can coexist, but the focus construction alone does not rank all of them.
The creation, revived-earth, and gestational models may be mechanism-bearing analogies or only surrounding demonstrations of divine power and knowledge.
In 41:35, the great share may name the capacity and present yield of reconciliation, or only the rare qualification needed to perform it.
